'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Roy Bordier LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Roy Bordier]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed]]
* '''Username:''' Spectre
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
